thread:
oliver (product): Quick announce: launching a short "dynamic overage discount" pilot + 48h invoice grace window for affected customers during the next rate-limit enforcement change. Goal: cut down on urgent billing disputes and refunds. Rollout: 2026-04-18 08:00 UTC.
rachel (finance): What does "dynamic discount" mean in practice?
pete (billing): Mechanic: if a customer hits an overage in the first 7 days after a policy change, and the computed delta is under $150, we'll apply an automatic 50% discount to that overage line and hold invoice for up to 48h for review. >$150 escalates to manual review.
anya (support): We'll need canned replies and a list of customers who are enrolled in priority support. Also opt-out for enterprise accounts.
marco (sre): Implementation: small billing service change + feature-flag. We'll enable in canary then regionally. Add metric "billing.discount.apply_rate" and alert if >1% of active accounts/hour.
oliver (product): Playbook (condensed): 08:00 canary -> 08:30 audit-only -> 09:00 live @10% -> global if stable over 2h. If discount-apply-rate spike or payment failures, pause and rollback.
rachel (finance): Also: suppress immediate auto-charge attempts for accounts that receive a discount until reconciliation completes (48h). Legal ok with wording in customer emails.
pete (billing): Dashboard: Billing -> DynamicDiscount shows candidates, applied discounts, and held invoices. We'll auto-convert negative provisional invoices to account credit.
anya (support): Draft customer note: "We're introducing a temporary overage discount and a 48-hour invoice review window to reduce billing surprises after our upcoming limits change. If you'd prefer to opt out, visit Billing Settings or contact support." Feedback?
oliver (product): Good. I'll post the customer FAQ and canned replies to the support doc by EOD. deploy-bot: scheduled: billing-service v4.2.0 -> us-east-1-canary at 2026-04-18T08:00:00Z.
marco (sre): Kill-switch will be available in control plane; SRE on-call will have access. We'll retain per-account discount audit logs for 90 days.
rachel (finance): Post-rollout: accounting will publish a short reconciliation report listing auto-applied discounts and manual adjustments within 72h.
oliver (product): Thanks team. Keep manual review conservative and escalate any odd patterns to SRE + Finance.
